comparison.objective: Vent the warm cryostat, wait, remove its sample and avoid disturbing the cold unit.
comparison.physical_skill: State-based selection, timed button actuation, lid removal and careful sample transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Correct button pressed, three-second wait observed, sample placed in tray; any cold-unit disturbance or premature opening fails.
comparison.reason: Tests safety reasoning, procedure order and careful extraction, not force-controlled fine adjustment or repeated impact validation. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
